campaign.objective: Build the first usable graph from sparse CRM records using existing CRM clients, source-aware schema mapping and tenant-declared CEG typed nodes and association endpoints; implement readback/replay test coverage for the terminal P4 rail. This is an implementation campaign in a single persistent CTO program: published stacked PRs and green code, not contracts only.
campaign.observable_done: Pre-integration phase exit: all in-scope code/docs changes are published in verified per-repository stacked PRs, all required native unit/contract/CI checks are green at exact PR heads, owner remediation complete, and the next phase has compatible contract evidence. Complete Docker/runtime graph proof remains deferred to P4 after all PRs publish. Non-Docker source-shaped CRM fixtures demonstrate domain-typed stable node identities, admitted association mapping, authorized Gate sync payloads and negative replay behavior. Actual CEG Neo4j node/edge persistence and readback are exclusively verified at final P4 G_RAIL.
campaign.priority_zero: Single-CTO series continuation: no phase restarts or separate operator activation. Require P0 dual-spec/route/doc receipts; map source record identifiers to graph identities before any bulk node or edge seed.

reserved_approvals: The operator activates this complete P0-P4 series ONCE under the current /lcto session; each later phase advances on accepted predecessor code/PR receipts, without a fresh discretionary activation. If the host session changes, use its governed continuity/adoption rather than relaunching a parallel CTO.

PR publication is pre-authorized for in-scope branches through the verified current make pr SSOT; the same-repository parent branch must be explicit and verified. Coding agents require no individual publication approval. Never use raw push.

The operator suspends repository-local AGENT.md and AGENTS.md documentation protected-file extra human-review requirements for this campaign. Agents may edit these files in their declared DOC lanes without requesting an additional human reviewer; retained higher-authority security, actual GitHub protections and reserved merge controls are not waived.

Use already available Cursor/Infisical secrets for least-privilege test and signed integration calls without asking again. No raw material in prompts, commits, logs, PR bodies or artifacts; absent keys are a precise external blocker, not a fabricated success.

All PRs remain unmerged until actual current merge authorization permits it. Do not ask for merge permission on every coding agent PR; CTO consolidates the exact subject(s) when necessary. This approval does not authorize production deploy, data mutation or changing Makefile/Repo.mk.

Continue through source-proven corrections, PR publication and agent-owned remediation until all component PRs are green; conduct one combined Docker integration acceptance on the joined heads AFTER all are published. No per-PR Docker ceremony, but never bypass required CI.

Makefile and Repo.mk in every repository are strictly out of write scope; neither the generated make-v1 facade nor its repository-owned implementation can be edited or regenerated as a workaround.
No direct edits to Cursor-Governance publication machinery, GitHub .github global semantics, unrelated application modules or deployment/production resources.
No pre-publication heavy Docker integration runs, no suppression of existing required CI checks, no fake PRs when no code correction is needed.
No raw git push, ungoverned gh pr create, force-push, arbitrary rebases, permissions bypass or secret leakage.
include: Use existing Odoo/HubSpot/Salesforce connector primitives to read record metadata and values; project onto approved domain node properties with original resource/id provenance.
Connect the existing crm_field_scanner and domain_spec_workflow to actual tenant records and stable CEG sync; keep unmapped fields visible.
Use CEG SyncGenerator and existing observed association producer; sync eligible associations only after both endpoints exist, with stable evidence_refs and idempotency.
Read actual seeded graph state from Neo4j under tenant and prove no client schema expansion/writeback was needed.
Update as-built README/architecture docs where P1 changes behavior; retain domain-neutral sentinel path.

A single persistent LCTO owns the complete P0-P4 program, integration and final disposition. One operator activation starts the series; later phases are gated continuation in that same session, not new operator approvals.

Preserve the same reusable CTO coding-agent pool, maximum five concurrent child agents or lower actual host capacity. Run independent disjoint work at once; keep each code writer as sole owner of its branch, affected files and PR remediation.

Stack every campaign PR on the verified previous campaign PR head within its own GitHub repository. Separate repositories have separate linear trains; bind cross-repository dependencies to pinned commit pairs in the CTO stack ledger.

Use the current Cursor-Governance governed make pr publication procedure exclusively. Verify the exact PR_BASE and resulting GitHub base/head, refuse ambiguous auto-stack/fallback, never raw push or direct PR creation.

Each coding agent owns its PR through native fast checks, required existing CI, reviewer comments, fixes and green current-head status. CTO schedules publication, evaluates integration and routes any defects back to the original writer.

No manual five-service Docker integration or repeated whole-system rail per PR or between phases. After ALL planned PRs in P0-P4 are published and green, test the final composite branch heads once; rerun only affected evidence and the final complete rail if integration defects require corrections.

Existing Infisical secrets available to Cursor are explicitly authorized for the bounded campaign test/integration need. Use the existing credential bindings, least-privilege scope and no logging/copying/committing secrets; availability is checked at use, not presumed.

For this campaign only, additional repository-local AGENT.md/AGENTS.md protected-file human-review ceremonies are waived for the declared documentation writer. Global policy, GitHub branch controls, security rules, and actual merge authority are not suspended.
